metadata.name: GTA VI-Inspired HUD 2.6.0 (GTA V Legacy)
metadata.description:
GTA VI-Inspired HUD for GTA V LEGACY (the original PC version, GTA5.exe). By FBICat. Fan-made and inspired by GTA VI. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. Some HUD art is taken from Rockstar's official GTA VI media and belongs to Rockstar Games. No GTA VI game files are included.
Need help? This is a fork of FBICat's VI HUD with its own support: discord.gg/C7gE5SHEzH, or a GitHub issue. FBICat's Discord is there for his original mod, so please bring questions about this version to ours. Thank you!
INSTALL - to the mods folder 1. This package. It also registers the HUD's DLC packs in dlclist.xml and raises the gameconfig.xml pools, which the separate RegisterPatch did up to 2.5.5: you don't need that any more. Installing over an older version is fine; no pack ends up listed twice. Lucia isn't included: her model is someone else's paid work. Get her from her creator: https://www.patreon.com/u10507693/posts/lucia-caminos-6-170646256 or MP Jason & Lucia V on gta5-mods.com: https://www.gta5-mods.com/player/mp-jason-lucia-v Jason isn't included either. Get him from the same creator: https://www.patreon.com/u10507693/posts/jason-duval-from-168652433 or Jason Duval character from GTA VI on mod-hub.net: https://mod-hub.net/mod/personazh-jason-duval-z-gta-vi-dlya-gta-5/?lang=en If a pack isn't registered, the HUD tells you in game. Game in C:\Program Files? Start OpenIV with right-click > Run as administrator, or the install can leave the old files in place. ViMinimap.asi must end up next to GTA5.exe; the minimap needs it to draw in fullscreen.
What it installs - HUD: scripts\GTA6Hud.dll + scripts\Hud\ (art, sounds, data) + scripts\GTA6Hud.ini - dlcpacks:/vihud/ FBICat's 2.1 HUD art and movies: weapon wheel, prompts, gauges, his VI pause menu - dlcpacks:/vihudfonts/ pause menu, HUD art and fonts, vehicle maker emblems - dlcpacks:/vihudanims/ body carry / loot animations, the crawl - 3D minimap: scripts\ViMinimap.dll + MiniMap.* data + ViMinimap.asi (in-game drawing) - Start screen: FBICat's VI landing page and loading screens, in update.rpf\x64\data\cdimages\scaleform_frontend.rpf - Registration, in update.rpf: the 3 packs in dlclist.xml; gameconfig.xml MetaDataStore 4000, ExprDictStore 400, TxdStore 150000, DwdStore 30000, MaxExtraPedModelInfos 600 - 2.5 features (separate scripts; GTA6Hud.dll is FBICat's 2.1 with small fixes: the gun shop on Enhanced, a lighter spin-out check, the HUD OPTIONS switches for these scripts, no interaction dots in cutscenes, and more): scripts\ViExtras.dll + scripts\ViExtras\ + ViExtras.ini honor, crosshair, focus, skills, NPC memory, crash cam, binoculars, radio, nitrous, wanted stars and box, police lights scripts\ViWasted.dll + ViWasted.ini WASTED / BUSTED scripts\ViCustoms.dll + scripts\ViCustoms\ + ViCustoms.ini Leonida Customs (GPL-3) scripts\ViCrouch.dll + scripts\ViCrouch\ + ViCrouch.ini crouch and crawl (GPL-3) scripts\ViSwitch.dll character switching: Michael, Franklin, Trevor, Jason and Lucia - No music: put your own mp3/wav files in scripts\Hud\Music and scripts\Hud\Radio\CustomMusic
Changes in 2.6.0 - One package to install: it registers the HUD's packs itself, so the RegisterPatch is gone. Lucia isn't included any more (see INSTALL above for where to get her, and Jason). - GTA VI's character switcher (hold Left Alt): a row of cards, Michael, Franklin and Trevor, then Jason and Lucia side by side, each with their honor face. Jason joins the wheel when his model is in your game. - Heists: rob the Fleeca banks, Pacific Standard and Vangelico. Case the place first, then pull a gun. - GTA VI's police lights, rebuilt from its trailer, and its police arrow. POLICE LIGHTS in HUD OPTIONS sizes them. - Carry every weapon: CARRY ALL WEAPONS in HUD OPTIONS (hold V), on by default; switch it off for FBICat's limit. Mk II weapons show their pictures on the wheel. - A game in Program Files gets fixed for you: Windows asks once to let the HUD save there. - LSPDFR on duty: no witnesses, no wanted level and no character switching. - Sniper rifles show their scope, the stun gun no longer jumps into your hands in a vehicle, and the Los Santos Customs garage doors roll up and down as in GTA V. - GTA VI's wanted box and its tells, smoother frame times, and many fixes (see the changelog on GitHub).
Changes in 2.5.5 - FBICat's VI HUD 2.1: GTA V-style character switching with Lucia as her own character, a new weapon wheel, his VI pause menu with ROBBER challenges, a kill cam that never freezes you, outfits, hats and new sounds. - FBICat's VI start screen (landing page and loading screens). - Updates really update now: the files carry their real dates, so Script Hook V .NET runs the new scripts. - Fixed: Lucia shown as missing, the radio opening while you pick a character in a car, interaction dots in cutscenes, selling the same car to the fence again and again. - Police memory is off, and people report you less often. - New pack vihud (this package switches it on; 2.5.5 needed RegisterPatch 1.7 for it). With NaturalVision Enhanced, copy vihud and vihudfonts into onigiri\dlcpacks and add dlcpacks:/vihud/ to NVE's dlclist.xml.
Changes in 2.5.4 - Your own music (On Demand) no longer freezes the game, and Left / Right in the radio wheel skip songs. - Ammu-Nation works on Enhanced again, and the HUD is smoother in traffic. - New switches in HUD OPTIONS (hold V): GREET / ANTAGONIZE, POLICE MEMORY, SPIN-OUTS, VI RADIO WHEEL. - Surrendering (hold E near a cop) fills every time, and fewer police patrols close in on you. - Greet / antagonize work on a controller (Y / B), and the wanted box's star is sharp again. - NaturalVision Enhanced: copy vihudfonts from mods\update\x64\dlcpacks into onigiri\dlcpacks again.
Changes in 2.5.3 - Switching to Michael, Franklin and Trevor works again, from the HUD's character wheel and with F5-F7, with the game's own sky camera. Lucia switches through the sky too ([Lucia] Enabled = True, the default).
Changes in 2.5.2 - Enhanced: GTA6Hud's own messages show ("Not enough money.", "Lose the cops first." ...), and its error log no longer fills up with the same error every 10 s. - Leonida Customs always lets you go when it closes, and leaving with Esc / B held no longer opens the pause menu or the cinematic camera. - Radio: your own music goes quiet over the pause menu and cutscenes, your car keeps its station when you get out, and D-pad Down in the radio wheel no longer opens the character wheel. - A nitrous kit changed in the shop works at once. - Standing still with the weapon wheel, a menu or the phone open near a cop no longer counts as giving up. - Steadier police, crouch and vehicle card scripts.
Changes in 2.5.1 - Lucia is a separate download now: GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-Lucia-Legacy.oiv (install it after this one and the RegisterPatch). This package is the HUD alone, and much smaller. - WASTED / BUSTED show every time, not just once a session, and frame the vehicle when you die in one. - Lucia: no more freeze when you load a save you quit as her. She only changes from the character wheel now. - Nitrous is on Left Shift (X / Square on a pad); Left Alt is GTA's character wheel. - Police only shoot to kill when you're armed at 3+ stars; otherwise they tase and arrest you. - Binoculars are on the weapon wheel (hold Tab, or LB on a pad), not on B. - GTA's own on-foot camera: no zooming in when you aim or fire, and V zooms out again. - The crawl moves its legs: each knee draws up as the opposite arm reaches, then pushes.
Changes in 2.5 (full list: CHANGELOG.md on GitHub) - Ported from the FiveM version: WASTED / BUSTED, honor, crosshair and kill marks, Focus, skills and gym, NPC memory, the FiveM crash cam, binoculars and radio, nitrous (in a car with a bottle), Leonida Customs (drive into an LS Customs garage), crouch (Left Ctrl twice) and crawl (Right Ctrl), the four-state wanted stars and wanted box, and directional police lights. - Fixed: Legacy black screen after dying; wanted box flickering; a crash while driving (traffic variety is off). - Lucia is no longer lent to the story characters near mission markers ([Lucia] MissionRange = 0). - Legacy: a lighter Lucia ped pack, so she no longer crashes outdoors while the world streams in.
Requirements (not included): Script Hook V, Script Hook V .NET 3, OpenIV with the mods folder (OpenIV.asi).
Known conflicts - Other add-on ped packs (AddonPeds, arthurmichael, big ped packs) and large map/arena packs use up the same game limits; if the game crashes (especially when switching to Lucia), disable those first. Known conflict: MzbArena. - Your progress lives in scripts\Hud\Save and is never touched by the package. - Problems: scripts\GTA6Hud.perf.log, scripts\GTA6Hud.error.log and scripts\MiniMap.log say what went wrong.
